$comment: Rules tools/test-select.mjs applies for what Vite's import graph cannot see. Every path is repo-relative and every pattern is a JavaScript regular expression. design/ci/fast-pipeline.md section 5 and design/ci/test-selection-replay.md explain each one; a miss found by the replay adds a rule here.

everything.$comment: A change to one of these runs every shard: the root package.json and patches change installed code; the rest decide how every shard runs. nx.json's sharedGlobals are added at run time. pnpm-lock.yaml is not here: test-select.mjs reads which importers of the lockfile changed and runs those packages as if their package.json changed (nx's projectsAffectedByDependencyUpdates: auto), and runs everything when it cannot tell.

smoke.$comment: A workflow change cannot change what a test computes, but a broken job command must still fail the change that broke it: a change to one of these runs one shard of each kind, a node shard and a browser shard (design/ci/channels-pipeline/merging.md section 4.3). Every other path under .github/ runs no test shard (noTests).

storySetup.$comment: visual-review files that only the packages' Storybook story setups load (.storybook/vitest.setup.visual.ts, a setup file of the storybook projects only). A change to one changes no dependent package's build, so instead of every shard of every package that depends on visual-review it runs visual-review's own shards and these story shards whole; the stories of layout and algorithms run in the Story tests job, which stories.global below selects. visual-review's other files (story-test.mjs and capture.mjs, which the vitest configs import) keep the dependency-wide answer.

noTests.$comment: Root paths no test shard reads: the screenshot lane, design notes and agent settings. Asked only after the import graphs and the test-side string literals (test-select.mjs, rootFiles), so a design file a test imports or names still runs that test. A root file that matches none of these and that no import, rule or test accounts for runs everything, except code under tools/.

wholePackage.$comment: A change matching one of these, inside a package, runs every shard of that package: data and recordings read at run time, and the files that decide how its tests run. A code file under the package's src/ is never matched (src/data/ holds data-source code): the import graph judges it. public/ is Vite's publicDir, served by URL (graphty's samples), which no import shows.

fileLevel.$comment: Packages whose shards may run a list of test files instead of the whole shard, adopted one by one as the replay shows no misses (design/ci/fast-pipeline.md section 5.1, item 2). A shard that runs a browser project still runs whole. Elsewhere the file-level answer is measured and logged, never used.

fileLevelBrowser.$comment: Packages of fileLevel whose shards that run a browser project may also run a list of test files (design/ci/minimal-tests.md section 3). A package joins only after tools/test-select-mutate.mjs finds no miss in its browser projects.

alsoRun.$comment: Packages that read another package's files without importing them and that nx's graph and the relative-path scan miss. Each entry: a changed path pattern and the packages whose shards then all run.

entries.why: their reference-page generators format with prettier.resolveConfig, which reads the root .prettierrc, in a child process

readAtRunTime.$comment: Data files. One that no test imports (a query-suffix import is an import) can only be read at run time, so a change to it runs the package's tests that read files (opaqueTest) instead of the whole package. A changed code file that no test imports still runs the whole package.

opaqueTest.$comment: A test whose own files (outside src/) read files, list directories or run programs at run time. Such a test runs whenever any file of its package other than another test changes, because what it reads is invisible to the import graph. Any use of child_process or node:fs counts, so a program run through promisify(execFile) is seen; so do ESLint (which loads its config at run time) and fetch() of a served file.

stories.$comment: Which stories a change runs (design/ci/channels-pipeline/stories-as-tests.md section 5). A change to a global path runs every story of every project; projectGlobal ({dir} is the project's Storybook directory) runs every story of that project; a lockfile change that moves a package matching lockfile runs every story (the one exception to the lockfile rule above: these change every picture); theme runs every story of the listed projects; drawnBy names, for a project with no story import graph, the packages whose selection runs all its stories (default: its own package). selectProjects: the projects whose stories are selected at all; every other project runs every story on every change. A project joins only after a clean run of node tools/test-select-mutate.mjs --stories <project>, which breaks its files one at a time, captures the whole Storybook and requires every story whose picture or play result changed to have been selected.
